output.explanation: The central tree shrinks from 110 to 69 raw lines (37%) and from 7,853 to 4,759 characters (39%). Five peripherals expand source selection, evidence dependencies, UI ownership, language-session lifetime and Git persistence. Logical component boundaries organize the trees; branches also describe calls, state ownership and data dependencies. Evidence is limited to context.json and seed.json. Source anchors: binding uses application/core/source/diagramSource.ts; evidence and panel use domain/mapping/code-panel/codePanel.ts and src/features/mapping/code-panel/CodePanel.tsx; lsp uses infrastructure/core/language-services/projectLanguageService.ts; git uses infrastructure/core/persistence/repositoryRegistry.ts. Central file access uses projectSource.ts, corpusAccess.ts and corpus.ts from the supplied sources. Corrections to seed shorthand: backward-line detection compares against the last merged range's start, not the previous item's start; the panel example demonstrates this distinction. Session sharing is scoped to each ProjectLanguageService instance. Reload/Retry send reload=true, but freshness beyond that boundary cannot be verified without the omitted codeRepo implementation. Added details include representation checks before live-diagram selection, deferred binding checks, request cleanup, refusal of workspace edits, null comparisonBase handling and registry queue cleanup. Imported mapping traversal, repository discovery, persistence helpers and path-validator implementations are absent; their internals are not inferred. Definition-target filtering shown here does not canonicalize each target; outsideRoot is returned but not displayed by CodePanel. Tree bounds were measured to ensure nonoverlapping positions, and edge endpoints identify meaningful concept lines.

|   |-- Load project; require reference.projectId to match
|   |-- Live diagram -> validate; check supplied contentId
|   |-- Saved representation -> requested or current revision must belong
|   |   `-- Scene -> exactly one diagram matching contentId or having a binding
|   |-- Otherwise merge catalog bindings + project.sources, filtered by sourceId
|   |   `-- Reject conflicting identities; require one binding -> source-query
|   |-- Supplied sourceId must match the chosen diagram
|   `-- Expose query, diagram, binding(), readText() and listFiles()
|       `-- File access needs binding.corpus + CorpusAccess; no project-wide default
|-- Selected nodes -> mapped evidence
|   |-- handleNodeSelect sorts nodes by line, then startColumn
|   |-- Require sourceContext.contentHash == content.asciiSha256
|   |-- Consume diagramSource entries; skip missing node, entity or range
|   |   |-- Repository reference = projectId + entity/binding sourceId fallback
|   |   `-- Path + inclusive one-based bounds + hash of captured originalLines
|   |-- resolveNodeResources returns matches and unmapped node IDs
|   |   `-- Attach selected-node, mapped-node and mapping provenance
|   |-- Deduplicate resource identity; append origins
|   `-- PanelContent carries diagram/revision/hash, selections and resources
|-- CodePanel -> source-range renderer -> display sections
|   |-- Keep item order; split on file/project/source changes
|   |   `-- Also split if startLine precedes last merged range's start
|   |-- Merge overlaps within a section; retain contributing items
|   |-- Read current file through codeRepo; show loading/error/retry states
|   |-- Normalize line endings; check every original target's range hash
|   |   `-- Past EOF or mismatch -> stale notice replaces that section's code
|   |-- Valid sections show highlighted ranges, folded gaps and origin labels
|   |   `-- Hover connects annotations with selected diagram nodes
|   |-- Browse source in same project/source; definition may change target path
|   `-- Back returns to ranges; panel changes reset browsing; retain scroll
|-- Bound file access through ProjectSourceService
|   |-- files -> resolveDiagramSource -> listFiles(directory)
|   |-- source -> resolveDiagramSource -> readText(path)
|   |   |-- Missing path -> invalid-input; NUL text -> binary-source
|   |   `-- Return lines from 1, whole-file SHA-256 and lspEnabled
|   |-- CorpusAccess exposes provider, readDocumentLines and discover
|   `-- Filesystem providers: git-worktree and filesystem-documents
|       |-- Canonicalize root; require matching kind and existing directory
|       |-- Relative components only; reject NUL, backslash, '.', '..' and empties
|       |-- Reject missing paths, symlink traversal and root escape
|       |-- listDirectory omits .git; directories first, then name/path order
|       `-- Read regular files as bytes/text/lines; range reads clamp at EOF
|-- Definition lookup -> navigation
|   |-- UI enables lookup for loaded, LSP-enabled, supported files
|   |-- Abort prior request; send path, position and loaded whole-file hash
|   |-- ProjectSourceService requires language adapter; resolves binding.corpus
|   |-- ProjectLanguageService validates path, position and current file hash
|   |   `-- Position must fit a line; LSP coordinates are zero-based UTF-16
|   |-- Canonical root keys lazy sessions within each service instance
|   |   |-- Start typescript-language-server over stdio; require UTF-16 definitions
|   |   |-- Serialize: initialize -> didOpen -> definition -> didClose
|   |   `-- Cancellation, timeout, failure and idle disposal govern lifetime
|   |-- Normalize Location/LocationLink; filter file URIs and relative paths
|   |   `-- Deduplicate path + range; return locations and outsideRoot count
|   `-- UI opens one result, offers many, or reports none
`-- Registered Git identity and change context
    |-- GitRepositoryRegistry persists repositories in project.json
    |-- Identity -> repo- + first 24 hex digits of SHA-256(identity)
    |-- Initialize only if repositories is absent
    |   `-- Discover checkout + Git source roots; merge identical repositories
    |-- Register merges names/roots; serialize writes per project file
    |-- Resolve checkout from saved roots, then current checkout
    |   `-- Require matching identity; unknown ID or unavailable checkout fails
    |-- Context needs explicit repositoryId or exactly one registered repository
    |-- Resolve head, commits and optional comparisonBase to commit SHAs
    |   `-- Cache ref resolution, deduplicate commits and validate context
    `-- captureHunks validates context -> resolves checkout -> captureGitHunks

Source binding selection and visibility
|-- Public resolver: resolveDiagramSource(store, ref, corpus?, liveDiagram?)
|   |-- Store boundary needs only loadProject and projectCatalogs
|   `-- A representationId triggers catalog/revision checks even with liveDiagram
|-- Diagram choice precedence
|   |-- Live diagram: validate; supplied contentId must equal diagram.id
|   |-- Saved scene: contentId selects identity, otherwise require a binding
|   `-- No live/saved diagram: collect registered source bindings
|       |-- Catalog bindings first, then project.sources
|       |-- Optional sourceId filters both collections
|       |-- Map keyed by sourceId rejects unequal root/kind/repositoryIdentity
|       `-- Exactly one entry -> synthetic diagram id=source-query, revision=0
|-- Selected diagram identity
|   `-- Supplied sourceId must equal sourceContext.binding.sourceId
`-- Deferred access checks
    |-- Resolver returns query and access functions
    |-- binding() throws only when called without a binding
    |-- readText/listFiles call binding(), then require corpus access
    `-- Dispatch to provider(binding.corpus); registry is not consulted here

Evidence dependencies and integrity gates
|-- Domain boundary: handlers perform no React rendering or file I/O
|   |-- source-range registers index, identity and buildDisplayModel
|   `-- CodePanel registers a separate renderer for that resource type
|-- Gate 1: diagram text identity
|   `-- sourceContext.contentHash != asciiSha256 -> reject mapping index
|-- Captured evidence -> resource target
|   |-- sourceId = entity.sourceId ?? binding.sourceId ?? empty string
|   |-- rangeSha256 = sha256(originalLines joined with LF)
|   `-- Identity includes type/project/source/path/start/end/rangeSha256
|-- Selection -> provenance
|   |-- Delegate matching to resolveNodeResources; traversal is not supplied
|   |-- Each origin gets selected and mapped IDs/labels plus mappingId
|   `-- Equal resources combine origins; selectedNodeIds are deduplicated
|-- Gate 2: current displayed range
|   |-- UI normalizes CRLF and lone CR to LF
|   |-- Each original target is checked, even inside a merged display range
|   `-- Any target beyond EOF or with unequal range hash hides section code
`-- Gate 3: definition request snapshot
    |-- UI sends loaded.sha256; service hashes current text before lookup
    `-- Whole-file mismatch requires reload, even outside mapped ranges

Display section and UI state ownership
|-- Display builder consumes items in their existing order
|   |-- New section on path/project/source change
|   |-- Compare new start with last merged range's start, not last item's start
|   |   `-- Example [10,30], [20,40], [15,16] stays one range [10,40]
|   `-- Overlap merges bounds/items; adjacent nonoverlapping ranges stay separate
|-- SourceRangeSections owns loaded/error/attempt and definition state
|   |-- Read effect depends on codeRepo, file.id and attempt
|   |-- Reload/Retry increment attempt; changed attempt sends reload=true
|   |-- Cleanup aborts file read and latest definition request
|   `-- Aborted results cannot update loaded data or definition messages
|-- Annotation ownership
|   |-- Display labels deduplicate origins by selectedNodeId
|   |-- Indirect origin adds mapped label via selectedId != mappedId
|   `-- Track highlighted DOM elements; clear attributes on exit/unmount
|-- CodePanel owns navigation and hovered-node state
|   |-- Browse creates source-code pane state for the same project/source
|   |-- Back clears navigation; content.panel changes also clear it
|   `-- Stage pointerover updates hover; cleanup removes listener
`-- Scroll state delegates to viewState.bind(documentId, paneId, @code-panel)
    |-- Active panel restores saved position; ResizeObserver retries after reads
    |-- Loading completion or wheel input stops restoration
    `-- Cleanup disconnects observer, wheel listener and scroll connection

Language session lifetime and lookup protocol
|-- ProjectLanguageService owns a map keyed by canonical corpus root
|   |-- Reuse live session; replace dead session on later lookup
|   `-- Map belongs to the service instance; panes can share that instance
|-- LanguageSession owns child process, RPC, ready promise, queue and idle timer
|   |-- Spawn Node with typescript-language-server; drain stderr
|   |-- Advertise UTF-16 and definition links; initialize tsserver
|   |-- Reject missing definitionProvider or explicit non-UTF-16 encoding
|   `-- workspace/applyEdit returns applied=false
|-- Queued lookup
|   |-- Clear idle timer -> await ready -> check dead/aborted state
|   |-- Install AbortSignal listener backed by CancellationTokenSource
|   |-- didOpen sends full text, version=1 and extension-based languageId
|   |-- Request textDocument/definition with a 20-second bound
|   |-- Finally remove abort listener, dispose token, didClose if alive
|   `-- Finally schedule idle; caught queue failure allows subsequent requests
|-- Disposal
|   |-- Initialization also has a 20-second bound; idle timer is five minutes
|   |-- Timeout, RPC error or child error/exit disposes session
|   |-- Mark dead; remove from liveSessions; clear idle; dispose RPC
|   |-- SIGTERM child PID on Windows, child process group elsewhere
|   `-- Service dispose clears map; process exit and SIGINT/SIGTERM clean up
`-- Response filtering
    |-- Prefer targetUri over uri; targetSelectionRange over range
    |-- Reject non-file URIs or invalid relative paths; increment outsideRoot
    |-- Deduplicate JSON-encoded path/range; no target realpath check here
    `-- UI uses locations; it does not display outsideRoot

Git registry persistence and context resolution
|-- Registry keeps project.json path and current checkoutRoot
|   `-- Module-level queue map serializes mutations by project file path
|       |-- A failed previous task does not block the next
|       `-- Remove queue entry only if it still refers to finishing task
|-- initialize
|   |-- Existing repositories field, including empty array -> return unchanged
|   |-- Discover current checkout plus git-worktree source roots
|   `-- Skip discovery failures; merge checkout roots by discovered identity
|-- register
|   |-- Discover requested path, initialize, then serialize update
|   |-- Name precedence: trimmed input, previous name, discovered name
|   `-- Merge unique checkout roots; update updatedAt; call writeJsonAtomic
|-- availableRoot
|   |-- Try saved roots before current checkout; skip discovery failures
|   `-- Accept first matching repository identity, not merely an existing path
`-- resolveContext
    |-- Choose explicit registered repository or sole registered entry
    |-- Use availableRoot; resolve refs with git rev-parse --verify
    |   |-- --end-of-options and ref^{commit}; default head is HEAD
    |   `-- Cache repeated refs; collect commits in a Set
    |-- comparisonBase omitted -> omitted; null -> null; ref -> resolved SHA
    `-- Parse context schema; captureHunks separately validates and delegates
